table_row.comqutor_alpha_embodiment: Alpha Memory: invalidation conditions, failed/expired structures stored with reason codes to adjust future activation

authoritative_spec_found.surrounding_context: The same table marks Structured job model, Structure Graph, Alpha Mapper, Activation Score, and Conflict Detector all as 'MVP' (some 'MVP (simplified formula)' / 'MVP (graph); full φ-token lifecycle deferred'). The 'Non-execution events as computational feedback' / Alpha Memory row is the ONLY row in this table marked plain 'Phase 2', alongside 'Stabilization condition + readout engine' (also Phase 2). The document's own MVP scope guard elsewhere states the full φ-token runtime is explicitly out of MVP scope.
authoritative_spec_found.meaning: The one and only place 'feedback loop' functionality is formally specified in this codebase is as a cross-run Alpha Memory: the system would need to persist failed/expired/non-executed Alpha structures with reason codes, across runs, and use that stored history to adjust a LATER run's activation score for the same or a related structure. This is explicitly a Phase 2 deliverable, not part of the current MVP.

current_implementation_status.conclusion: The cross-run computational feedback loop described in the Development Plan does not exist in the current codebase. This is expected and correct per the Plan's own phasing -- it was never scheduled for MVP/v0.1.x.

action_taken_this_task: Per Section F's explicit instruction not to invent a Product definition: no new 'feedback loop' mechanism was implemented.
